evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 5.5 ppm, near the established post-purge baseline of approximately 3–6 ppm.
Oxygen rose to 13.2 ppm during growth.
Oxygen continued rising to 27.1 ppm after reaching 19.4 ppm at 2880 s.
Oxygen reached 33.2 ppm, showing sustained departure from the post-purge baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon 99.9 sccm track setpoints; pressure remains stable at 761.0 Torr, heater power is 44.6%, and status is running despite the oxygen rise.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and a seal/gas-path integrity test are needed to distinguish air ingress from gas contamination, outgassing, or oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
